title: Secondary Sanctions Risk for Saudi Banks (2025): Keeping USD Correspondents While Financing Vision 2030

detail.title: Secondary Sanctions Risk for Saudi Banks (2025): Keeping USD Correspondents While Financing Vision 2030
detail.abstract: Since mid-2024, US measures have raised secondary-sanctions exposure for foreign financial institutions that facilitate Russia-related transactions, and the June 2024 OFAC advisory highlights foreign correspondent relationships as an area of significant residual risk. Saudi bankswhile not party to EU/US sanctions regimesmust protect USD-clearing access and correspondent relationships that are central to Vision 2030 financing. This paper sizes the problem, translates recent Western measures into concrete risk controls, and proposes a ready-to-implement framework covering governance, data, transaction controls, trade finance, maritime exposure, and post-transaction investigations without resorting to blanket de-risking, consistent with the FATF risk-based approach and SAMA guidance.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2024年美国对俄罗斯相关交易的外国金融机构二级制裁风险，为沙特银行提供保护美元清算通道和代理行关系的具体风险控制框架。
AI.research_question: 沙特银行如何在遵守西方制裁措施的同时保护美元清算通道和代理行关系？
AI.motivation: 2024年美国措施增加了外国金融机构为俄罗斯相关交易提供便利的二级制裁风险，沙特银行虽不参与欧盟/美国制裁制度，但必须保护对2030愿景融资至关重要的美元清算通道和代理行关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于FATF风险为本方法和SAMA监管指引的风险管理理论框架。
AI.method: 问题规模评估、西方措施转化为具体风险控制、提出可实施框架。
AI.findings: 提出了覆盖治理、数据、交易控制、贸易融资、海事风险敞口和交易后调查的全面风险控制框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 将西方制裁措施转化为可操作的风险控制框架，避免一刀切去风险化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为沙特银行提供保护美元清算通道和代理行关系的具体实施方案，支持2030愿景融资需求。

title: Transition linkers in Latin America
affiliations: and Anthropocene Fixed Income Institute

detail.title: Transition linkers in Latin America
detail.abstract: Inflation-linked bonds are well established in Latin America. Could the underlying concept of performance-linked debt instruments be applied to other areas like decarbonisation or nature conservation? That's the idea of transition linkers, a new type of bond structure which allows investors to hedge risky asset return correlation with progress on transition. The defining feature is a coupon rate that adjusts in steps depending on whether the issuing country meets, exceeds, or falls short of its targets. Expanding on earlier work focused on the energy transition, we explore how this concept could also be applied in the context of nature, outlining opportunities and challenges with a focus on the regional context in Latin America. Building on portfolio theory, we analyse how transition linkers can play a key role in asset allocation under the hypothesis that unsuccessful transitions could lead to lower or more volatile returns on risky assets. At the same time, such a bond structure provides fiscal incentives for governments to foster policies that increase the transition likelihood. The paper builds on a pricing approach for transition linkers and discusses various structural implementations to accommodate traditional mainstream fixed income markets. Finally, it analyses hypothetical transition linker structures for key countries in Latin America.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了将通胀挂钩债券的概念扩展到脱碳和自然保护领域的转型挂钩债券，分析了其在拉丁美洲的应用潜力、定价方法和结构设计。
AI.research_question: 如何将通胀挂钩债券的概念应用于脱碳和自然保护领域，特别是在拉丁美洲地区？
AI.motivation: 通胀挂钩债券在拉丁美洲已成熟应用，但能否将其概念扩展到其他重要领域如脱碳和自然保护，以帮助投资者对冲转型风险并为政府提供政策激励。

AI.method: 基于定价方法分析转型挂钩债券，讨论不同结构设计以适应传统固定收益市场，并分析拉丁美洲主要国家的假设性结构。
AI.findings: 转型挂钩债券可以通过调整票面利率来反映国家转型目标的完成情况，为投资者提供对冲工具，同时为政府提供财政激励。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了挂钩债券的理论框架，将通胀挂钩概念应用于环境和社会转型领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为拉丁美洲国家提供了具体的转型挂钩债券结构设计方案，有助于推动脱碳和自然保护政策的实施。

title: The Impact of Maternal Mortality Improvements on the Baby Boom
affiliations: University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill and Washington and Lee University

detail.title: The Impact of Maternal Mortality Improvements on the Baby Boom
detail.abstract: Between 1936 and 1957, fertility rates in the U.S. increased 62 percent and the maternal mortality rate declined by 93 percent. We explore the effects of changes in maternal mortality rates on white and nonwhite fertility rates during this period, exploiting contemporaneous or lagged changes in maternal mortality at the state-by-year level. We estimate that declines in maternal mortality explain 47-73 percent of the increase in fertility between 1939 and 1957 among white women and 64-88 percent of the increase in fertility among nonwhite women during our sample period.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，1936-1957年间美国孕产妇死亡率下降解释了白人女性生育率增长的47-73%和非白人女性生育率增长的64-88%。
AI.research_question: 孕产妇死亡率变化对白人和非白人女性生育率的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 1936-1957年间美国生育率上升62%，孕产妇死亡率下降93%，需要探究两者之间的因果关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于健康经济学和人口学理论，孕产妇健康改善会影响生育决策。
AI.method: 利用州级年度孕产妇死亡率变化的同期或滞后效应进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 孕产妇死亡率下降显著解释了白人和非白人女性生育率增长的大部分原因。
AI.theory_contributions: 为健康改善对生育行为的影响提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共卫生政策制定提供了重要参考，强调改善孕产妇健康对人口增长的重要性。

reference: Widener Law Commonwealth Research Paper Forthcoming
title: Public Natural Resources, Common Property, and the Public Trust Doctrine
affiliations: Widener University - Commonwealth Law School

detail.title: Public Natural Resources, Common Property, and the Public Trust Doctrine

publicationDetails.detailsText: Widener Law Commonwealth Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: Widener University Commonwealth Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This Article addresses an important question of Pennsylvania constitutional public trust law that is also central to understanding the public trust doctrine and the role it plays and can continue to play in other states and countries to address pressing environmental challenges. The public trust clause of Pennsylvania’s environmental rights amendment recognizes the Commonwealth’s responsibility to “conserve and maintain” “public natural resources” for the benefit of present and future generations. The state’s supreme court has held that the Commonwealth has a fiduciary duty to conserve and maintain the public trust corpus—public natural resources—with prudence, loyalty, and impartiality. And it has held that present and future generations are simultaneous beneficiaries of this public trust. All of this is designed to protect public natural resources. But an important question about the constitutional text remains: what does it mean for “public natural resources” to be “the common property of all the people, including generations yet to come?”

This Article answers the question by arguing, first, that “public natural resources” include resources that can be owned in a conventional sense, like state forest and park land, as well as air, water, fish, and wildlife, that cannot be categorically owned in a conventional sense. Second, it explains the Commonwealth’s duties in managing “common property”—duties that are based on longstanding public trust law and that supplement and reinforce those described above. Simply put, these duties involve public availability of public natural resources, which includes but is not limited to their protection. Because public natural resources are “the common property of all the people, including generations yet to come,” they cannot be private property. The Commonwealth must ensure that they are used only for trust purposes, and that they are available to present and future generations. The Commonwealth cannot transfer ownership or control of public natural resources to private parties in ways that compromise their public availability or the terms of the trust.

This understanding of Pennsylvania’s public trust clause provides a basis for strengthened protection of public natural resources. It also gives full effect to all of the words of the public trust clause. And it answers arguments that “common property” limits the meaning of public natural resources to property that can be owned in a conventional sense.

The concept of common property, moreover, is central to the meaning of the public trust doctrine, not only in Pennsylvania but in other states and countries. It focuses the government’s trust duties on those natural resources most essential for human survival and well-being. It helps ensure that these resources can be used and enjoyed by all people in present and future generations, regardless of income or social status, not just some. And the concept of common property protects the availability of these resources for future generations because future availability requires their conservation and maintenance by the current generation. All of these are needed in the years and decades ahead because of the many environmental challenges society faces, including climate change.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了宾夕法尼亚州宪法公共信托条款中"公共自然资源"作为"所有人民共同财产"的含义，主张这些资源包括可传统拥有的资源（如州森林和公园土地）以及不可传统拥有的资源（如空气、水、鱼类和野生动物），并阐述了政府在管理这些共同财产时的信托责任。
AI.research_question: 宾夕法尼亚州宪法公共信托条款中"公共自然资源"作为"所有人民共同财产"的具体含义是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解公共信托条款对解决当前环境挑战的重要性，以及澄清"共同财产"概念对加强公共自然资源保护的必要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共信托理论、环境权利修正案、信托责任理论
AI.method: 法律文本分析、判例研究、理论论证
AI.findings: 1）公共自然资源包括可传统拥有和不可传统拥有的资源；2）政府有责任确保这些资源的公共可获得性；3）政府不能以损害公共利益的方式将公共自然资源转让给私人。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对公共信托条款中"共同财产"概念的理解，为公共信托理论在其他州和国家的应用提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加强公共自然资源保护提供了法律依据，确保当前和未来世代都能公平享有这些资源，特别是在应对气候变化等环境挑战时。

title: From Market Waste to Green Wealth: Rethinking Kangemi’s Fresh Food Wastage

detail.title: From Market Waste to Green Wealth: Rethinking Kangemi’s Fresh Food Wastage

publicationDetails.detailsText: yes

detail.abstract: Markets across Africa are both food baskets and waste centres. Kangemi, like many urban markets in Kenya, faces the waste management issue of plenty: fresh food comes in, but tons of it end up as waste. This paper reflects on four years of daily observations and proposes circular economy pathways—Black Soldier Fly (BSF) farming, composting into manure, coir (coco-pit) products, and waste-based innovations like mats, baskets, and threads. Using examples from Kenya, Uganda, and Nigeria, as well as global lessons, the paper demonstrates how waste transformation can create green jobs and enhance food security.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了非洲市场（以肯尼亚Kangemi市场为例）的食物浪费问题，提出了通过黑水虻养殖、堆肥、椰壳纤维产品和废物创新等循环经济途径，将食物垃圾转化为绿色就业机会和提升粮食安全。
AI.research_question: 如何通过循环经济途径解决非洲市场的食物浪费问题，并创造绿色就业机会和提升粮食安全？
AI.motivation: 非洲市场既是食品篮子又是废物中心，大量新鲜食品最终成为废物，面临严重的废物管理问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 循环经济理论，强调废物转化为资源的价值创造过程。
AI.method: 基于四年日常观察，结合肯尼亚、乌干达、尼日利亚的案例研究以及全球经验。
AI.findings: 通过黑水虻养殖、堆肥、椰壳纤维产品和废物创新等途径，可以有效转化食物垃圾，创造绿色就业机会，并提升粮食安全。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了循环经济理论在发展中国家食物垃圾管理中的应用，提供了具体的实施路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲市场提供了可行的废物管理解决方案，创造了绿色就业机会，提升了粮食安全水平。

title: Proactive Or Reactive: Conflict-Reducing Timing of Third-Party Intervention in a Rent-Seeking Contest

detail.title: Proactive Or Reactive: Conflict-Reducing Timing of Third-Party Intervention in a Rent-Seeking Contest

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by JSPS KAKENHI Grant Number JP24KJ0569.

detail.abstract: This study develops a model of third-party intervention in a rent-seeking contest, focusing on how the timing of intervention shapes conflict outcomes. Using a two-stage Tullock contest framework with two contestants and a biased third party, it compares the results of proactive (ex-ante) and reactive (ex-post) interventions. The main finding is that proactive intervention may escalate the equilibrium level of conflict, while reactive intervention can mitigate it, highlighting the crucial role of timing in conflict dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个寻租竞争中第三方干预的模型，重点分析干预时机如何影响冲突结果。研究发现主动（事前）干预可能加剧冲突，而被动（事后）干预能够缓解冲突。
AI.research_question: 第三方干预的时机如何影响寻租竞争中的冲突结果？
AI.motivation: 理解第三方干预时机在冲突动态中的关键作用，为冲突管理提供理论指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于两阶段Tullock竞争框架，包含两个竞争者和一个有偏见的第三方。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，比较主动（事前）和被动（事后）干预的均衡结果。
AI.findings: 主动干预可能加剧均衡冲突水平，而被动干预能够缓解冲突。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了第三方干预时机对冲突影响的正式模型，深化了对冲突动态的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为冲突管理者提供了关于干预时机选择的实践指导，强调被动干预在缓解冲突中的有效性。

Education Stock in India, 1992-2021. 

Levels, Temporal Variation and Spatial Distribution

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not required.
declarations.funderStatement: There is no funding.

detail.abstract: This paper proposes education stock, a composite measure  to assess the educational status of the population that accounts for the size of the educated population - population having at least one completed year of schooling - distribution of the educated population by different categories of completed years of schooling and assigns higher weight to the population having at least 10 completed years of schooling relative to the population having less than 10 completed years of schooling.  Application of the proposed indicator to India reveals that there is substantial scope of increasing the education stock in India, although there has been an increase in the education mass over the years. The paper highlights significant temporal variations and pervasive spatial distribution in the education mass across states and Union Territories of the country and across districts within states/Union Territories. In majority of the districts of the country, the gender disparity in the education stock is high to exceptionally high, although there are districts in which female education stock is greater than the male education stock. The prevailing education stock in the country shows that the human capital in India stays below the average and is not conducive to high productivity of the social and economic production system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了'教育存量'这一综合指标来评估人口教育状况，该指标考虑了受教育人口规模、受教育年限分布，并对完成10年以上教育的人口赋予更高权重。应用于印度的研究表明，尽管教育总量有所增长，但印度教育存量仍有大幅提升空间，存在显著的时间变化和空间分布差异，多数地区性别差距严重，整体人力资本水平低于平均水平。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个综合的教育存量指标来评估人口教育状况，并应用于印度的实证分析？
AI.motivation: 需要开发一个能够全面反映人口教育状况的综合指标，以更好地评估人力资本水平和教育发展状况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教育存量理论、人力资本理论、教育发展评估框架
AI.method: 构建教育存量综合指标，包括受教育人口规模、受教育年限分布，并对高教育水平人口赋予更高权重；应用该指标对印度各邦、联邦属地和地区进行实证分析
AI.findings: 1) 印度教育存量虽有增长但仍有大幅提升空间；2) 存在显著的时间变化和空间分布差异；3) 多数地区性别差距严重；4) 部分地区女性教育存量超过男性；5) 整体人力资本水平低于平均，不利于社会经济生产系统的高效运行
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了教育存量这一新的综合评估指标，丰富了教育发展和人力资本评估的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估教育发展状况的有效工具，有助于识别教育发展的区域差异和性别差距，为教育政策制定提供实证依据

title: The Entry Multiplier
affiliations: Columbia University

detail.title: The Entry Multiplier
detail.abstract: Local employment growth is both very persistent in the medium run, and varies widely across space. Establishment entry plays the dominant role in this variation. Establishments do not exit at different rates across space, and the composition of establishment and firm types does not change as areas grow. I propose that part of the persistence of local growth arises from an endogenous entry multiplier. New establishments raise labor demand, increase local spending and attract new workers, who in turn increase the demand for new establishments. Quantitatively, convergence is slow, and local shocks propagate far into the future. This process working in reverse appears crucial to explain the decline of the US Rust Belt.

AI.tldr: 本地就业增长在中期内具有高度持续性，且空间差异显著。企业进入是这种差异的主要驱动因素。企业退出率在空间上没有显著差异，企业类型构成也不随地区增长而变化。作者提出本地增长持续性的部分原因来自内生的进入乘数效应：新企业增加劳动力需求，提升本地支出并吸引新工人，这些工人反过来又增加对新企业的需求。定量分析显示收敛缓慢，本地冲击会长期传播。这一过程的逆向运作对解释美国锈带衰退至关重要。
AI.research_question: 本地就业增长的持续性及其空间差异的驱动机制是什么？企业进入在其中的作用如何？
AI.motivation: 本地就业增长在中期内表现出高度持续性，且在不同地区间存在显著差异，但现有研究对这种现象的驱动机制理解不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内生进入乘数理论：新企业进入通过增加劳动力需求、提升本地支出和吸引新工人，形成正向反馈循环，从而维持本地就业增长的持续性。
AI.method: 定量分析方法，通过实证数据检验企业进入、退出和类型构成的空间差异，以及本地冲击的传播效应。
AI.findings: 1. 企业进入是本地就业增长空间差异的主要驱动因素；2. 企业退出率在空间上没有显著差异；3. 企业类型构成不随地区增长而变化；4. 本地冲击具有长期传播效应，收敛过程缓慢。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了内生进入乘数理论，解释了本地就业增长的持续性机制，为理解区域经济发展的路径依赖提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为区域经济政策制定提供了理论依据，特别是对理解美国锈带衰退等区域经济问题的成因具有重要启示。

title: Dynamic Competition for Sleepy Deposits
affiliations: Harvard University - Business School (HBS), University of Chicago, Harvard Business School, Harvard University and Georgia State University - J. Mack Robinson College of Business

detail.title: Dynamic Competition for Sleepy Deposits

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2025-128
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We examine the implications of sleepy deposits and their impact on competition, bank value, and financial stability in the US banking sector. We first document the shopping behavior of depositors using novel data on account openings and closures. Depositors infrequently shop for deposits, with 5-15% of depositors opening a new account each year. Shopping behavior is idiosyncratic: deposit accounts are more likely to be closed due to the depositor either moving or dying than because the depositor switched to a new account offering higher rates or better services. Building on these facts, we develop an empirical model of the supply and demand for "sleepy deposits." In the model, banks face dynamic "invest-versus-harvest" incentives in competing for depositors who shop infrequently. We estimate the model and find that depositor sleepiness accounts for 58% of the average bank's deposit franchise value. Sleepiness softens competition, particularly raising markups and franchise value for banks in low-concentration areas, as well as for banks with either low-quality deposit services or high marginal costs. Sleepiness also creates stability in the banking sector. For two main money center banks in the US, the probability of default after the Federal Reserve's 2022-2023 hiking cycle would have increased to more than 20% in a counterfactual without sleepy depositors.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了"沉睡存款"对美国银行业竞争、银行价值和金融稳定的影响。研究发现储户很少更换存款账户，这种"沉睡性"占银行平均存款特许价值的58%，削弱了竞争并提高了银行价值，同时也增强了金融稳定性。
AI.research_question: 沉睡存款如何影响银行业的竞争、银行价值和金融稳定性？
AI.motivation: 理解储户行为对银行业竞争动态和稳定性的影响，特别是储户不频繁更换存款账户的现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于储户购物行为的实证模型，银行面临"投资vs收获"的动态激励，竞争那些不频繁更换账户的储户。
AI.method: 使用新颖的账户开立和关闭数据，建立存款供需的实证模型并进行估计。
AI.findings: 储户很少更换存款账户（每年5-15%），账户关闭更多是因为搬家或死亡而非寻求更高利率。沉睡性占银行平均存款特许价值的58%，在低集中度地区、低服务质量或高边际成本的银行中影响更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了储户沉睡性对银行业竞争和稳定性的理论框架，揭示了银行特许价值的重要来源。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了理解银行业稳定性的新视角，在美联储加息周期中，如果没有沉睡储户，主要货币中心银行的违约概率将超过20%。

title: A Combination-Therapy Stack for Governing Frontier-Scale AI

detail.title: A Combination-Therapy Stack for Governing Frontier-Scale AI

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No financial relationship with any other people or financial organisations
declarations.funderStatement: Self funded

detail.abstract: Frontier-scale AI capability is doubling in months while regulation moves in years. Grounded in a stewardship ethos of oneness, service, and the welfare of all (see Section 1.5), this paper sets out a Nine-Layer “Combination Therapy” Stack that governs both inputs (compute, data, energy) and behaviours (dangerous-capability vetoes, provenance, externalities), with enforceability on today’s hardware and a clear pivot as architectures change. Layer 1 caps training runs in Effective Compute Units (ECU)—enforced through tradable ECU credits (EUCs)—and automatically pivots to energy-timestamp attestation (tokens secondary) when non-von-Neumann/neuromorphic accelerators exceed 15% of frontier share for two consecutive quarters, preserving a tamper-resistant meter across paradigms. The architecture interlocks ACC (L1), DCT (L2), CCT (L3), Telemetry (L4), Provenance (L5), Rights-Clean Data (L6), Sustainability (L7), Graduated Joint Liability (L8), and Citizen Assemblies (L9), and governs at the system boundary via SCID and W-ECU so orchestrated swarms cannot evade oversight. A transparent model estimates the 10-year implementation cost of US $ 91–233 B (NPV) and risk-adjusted benefit NPV (5th–95th) of US $ 2.04–4.66 T, yielding B/C > 10:1 under central assumptions and remaining strongly positive under sensitivity tests. (Costs and run instructions are provided in the replication pack.) Fault-tree analysis shows the Stack reduces 10-year catastrophic-incident probability from a conservative ≈ 15% baseline to ≈ 3.8% in the worked example. All equations, calibration rules (including the ECU pivot), dependence treatment, and valuation are in Appendix H; Appendix I contains copy-paste replication artifacts. We do not stop AI—we steer it: cap only extreme runs, test dangerous behaviours, trace outputs, and price residual risk so innovation—especially for small labs—continues at lower tail risk and modest cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个九层"组合疗法"框架来治理前沿AI，通过计算单元上限、危险能力否决、溯源等机制，在保持创新的同时降低灾难性风险。该框架估计实施成本910-2330亿美元，风险调整收益2.04-4.66万亿美元，效益成本比>10:1。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个可执行的治理框架来管理前沿AI的发展，在保持创新的同时降低灾难性风险？
AI.motivation: 前沿AI能力以月为单位翻倍，而监管以年为单位推进，存在治理滞后风险。基于服务全体福利的管护伦理，需要建立及时的治理机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于管护伦理（oneness, service, welfare of all）和组合疗法概念，构建多层治理框架。
AI.method: 提出九层治理堆栈，包括计算上限、危险能力测试、溯源等机制，使用有效计算单元（ECU）作为计量基础，并设计向非冯·诺依曼架构的自动转换机制。
AI.findings: 该框架估计10年实施成本910-2330亿美元，风险调整收益2.04-4.66万亿美元，效益成本比>10:1，能将灾难性事件概率从15%降至3.8%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了跨AI架构的治理框架，设计了可执行的治理机制，包括计算单元上限和自动转换机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了具体的实施路径和成本效益分析，为政策制定者提供了可操作的治理工具包，支持小型实验室在低风险下继续创新。

title: Learning Models from Prices
affiliations: Ca Foscari University of Venice - Dipartimento di Economia and University of Bologna, Department of Economics

detail.title: Learning Models from Prices

publicationDetails.detailsText: Ca' Foscari University of Venice, Department of Economics Research Paper Series No. 17/2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Department of Economics, Ca' Foscari University of Venice Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study a dynamic financial economy with complete markets in which agents hold heterogeneous beliefs about dividends. Beliefs combine an exogenous agent-specific model, possibly misspecified, and an endogenous market-based model derived from state prices. We show that using prices to learn improves prediction and offers a hedge against model misspecification. With Bayesian learning, agents update model weights and survive on all paths. Market beliefs converge almost surely to the most accurate exogenous model, despite heterogeneity and misspecification, and so do individual beliefs of any agent who assigns positive prior weight to it. With non-Bayesian learning, where the weight on the market model is fixed, survival is not guaranteed. Yet market accuracy weakly improves, and can exceed that of any individual model when beliefs are diverse. In such cases, relying on prices helps approximate the truth, while ignoring the market leads to vanishing. Our results characterize how endogenous use of prices shapes learning, survival, and the predictive power of markets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个具有异质信念的完全市场动态金融经济，探讨了代理人如何结合外生个体模型和基于市场价格的内生市场模型进行学习。研究发现，使用价格学习能改善预测并对抗模型误设，在贝叶斯学习下信念会收敛到最准确的外生模型，而在非贝叶斯学习下市场准确性也会提升。
AI.research_question: 在异质信念的完全市场环境中，代理人如何通过结合外生个体模型和基于市场价格的内生市场模型进行学习？这种学习如何影响预测准确性、代理人存活和市场信念的收敛？
AI.motivation: 研究代理人如何在金融市场上利用价格信息来改进预测并应对模型误设问题，探讨市场在异质信念环境下的学习机制和效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于异质信念的完全市场动态金融经济理论，结合贝叶斯学习和非贝叶斯学习框架，分析代理人信念更新和市场信念收敛机制。
AI.method: 理论建模分析，构建动态金融经济模型，研究代理人在异质信念环境下结合外生个体模型和内生市场模型的学习过程。
AI.findings: 1) 使用价格学习能改善预测并对抗模型误设；2) 贝叶斯学习下代理人会存活且信念收敛到最准确的外生模型；3) 非贝叶斯学习下市场准确性提升，可能超过任何个体模型；4) 忽视市场信息会导致代理人消失。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了异质信念环境下代理人结合价格信息的学习理论框架；2) 阐明了市场信念收敛到最准确模型的机制；3) 揭示了价格在学习和生存中的内生作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为投资者提供了利用市场价格改进预测的策略；2) 强调了在异质信念环境中关注市场信息的重要性；3) 为理解金融市场学习机制提供了理论指导。

title: BETWIXT AND BETWEEN: RESTORATIVE JUSTICE, DEI, AND EDUCATION CARCERALITY
affiliations: University of California College of the Law, San Francisco

detail.title: BETWIXT AND BETWEEN: RESTORATIVE JUSTICE, DEI, AND EDUCATION CARCERALITY
detail.abstract: American K-12 public education is at a critical anti-civil rights inflection point amidst a rapidly changing landscape of federal and state education law and policy. From local anti-literacy measures to state "three strikes" exclusionary school discipline legislation to punitive federal executive orders, new legal mechanisms are conjoining to produce public school climates marked by structural violence, and the erasure of students with multiple marginalized identities. Attending to these political and legal realities is a growing cluster of legal scholarship empirically categorizing, and theoretically challenging, the rise of such anti-education civil rights obstructions. Though diverse in scope, analyses prominently center the direct effects of individual and structural mechanisms to police, punish, and exclude students from classrooms and schools. This focus has created an unattended space in the literature for interrogations centering broader collateral consequences of an expanding educational retrenchment movement. It is in this liminal gap in which this Article intervenes. Specifically, it extends prior work querying the future of school-based restorative justice under early forms of anti-woke legislation and "parental right" activism and examines new state and federal attacks on American public education that may limit the ability to advance, and in many instances, maintain restorative justice practices, policies, and programs in K-12 schools.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美国K-12公共教育面临的反民权危机，探讨了反觉醒立法和家长权利运动如何限制学校恢复性司法实践的发展与维持。
AI.research_question: 新的州和联邦对公共教育的攻击如何限制K-12学校推进和维持恢复性司法实践的能力？
AI.motivation: 现有文献主要关注直接排斥学生的机制，而忽视了教育收缩运动更广泛的附带后果，特别是对恢复性司法实践的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构暴力理论、反民权法律机制分析、教育收缩运动理论
AI.method: 法律政策分析、文献综述、理论扩展
AI.findings: 反觉醒立法和家长权利运动正在创造限制恢复性司法实践的法律环境，威胁学校公平正义的实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了教育收缩运动附带后果研究的空白，扩展了恢复性司法在反民权背景下的理论分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育工作者和政策制定者提供了应对反民权法律挑战的策略，维护学校恢复性司法实践的空间。

reference: University of Chicago Law School, Coase-Sandor Institute for Law & Economics Research Paper No. 25-30
title: Taxes and Reported versus True Income
affiliations: University of Chicago - Harris School of Public Policy and University of Chicago - Law School

detail.title: Taxes and Reported versus True Income

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago Law School, Coase-Sandor Institute for Law & Economics Research Paper No. 25-30
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Chicago Law School, Coase-Sandor Institute for Law & Economics Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Studies that use tax data to examine income inequality (for example Piketty and Saez, 2003; Piketty et al., 2018a; Auten and Splinter, 2024; Fixler et al., 2020) must confront the issue of tax misreporting (including most prominently tax evasion). To derive an estimate of top true shares of income, researchers must allocate estimates of misreporting to reported income based on limited data. Research groups use different methods of making this allocation, and these differences have large effects on estimated top shares. To help understand the effects of different allocation methods, we lay out a statistical framework for the relationship between true income, reported income, and misreporting, treating the density of reported income as data generated by behavioral primitives: the densities of true income and misreporting. We use this framework to clarify the methodologies and assumptions used by two research groups, Piketty et al. (2018a) and Auten and Splinter (2024), together with the recent comparison by Iselin and Reck (2025). 

We show that the approach used by Piketty et al. (2018a) and supported by Iselin and Reck (2025) which assumes that misreporting is proportional to reported income, rules out, by assumption, plausible and central cases for how misreporting can affect estimates of true income. If misreporting is heterogeneous (in the sense that people with a given type of income and within and income class misreport at different levels) rather than proportional, misreporting may show up towards the bottom of the reported income distribution even if it originates at the top. Accurately accounting for that misreporting may reduce rather than increase top shares of income. Moreover, an increase in top reported shares need not be accompanied by an increase in top true shares. The approach recommended by PSZ and Iselin and Reck is also not supported by the available data. It is not, therefore, an appropriate method for accounting for misreporting. Instead, researchers should work with the microdata on the pattern of misreporting, focusing on the heterogeneity of miresporting within income groups. We argue further that any approach for imputing true income from reported income and assumptions about misreporting should explicitly take into account the uncertainty in misreporting rather than relying on point estimates.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了使用税收数据研究收入不平等时面临的税收误报问题，比较了Piketty等人和Auten与Splinter两种不同的误报分配方法，指出Piketty等人的比例误报假设存在问题，建议应关注误报的异质性并使用微观数据。
AI.research_question: 不同税收误报分配方法如何影响收入不平等估计？
AI.motivation: 税收数据研究收入不平等必须处理税收误报问题，不同研究组使用不同的误报分配方法，这些差异对估计的顶层收入份额有重大影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 建立了一个统计框架，描述真实收入、报告收入和误报之间的关系，将报告收入密度视为由真实收入密度和误报密度的行为原语生成的数据。
AI.method: 通过理论框架分析比较Piketty等人(2018a)和Auten与Splinter(2024)的方法论和假设，以及Iselin和Reck(2025)的比较研究。
AI.findings: Piketty等人的比例误报假设排除了误报异质性的合理情况，如果误报是异质的，即使误报源自顶层，也可能出现在报告收入分布的底部，准确考虑这种误报可能降低而非增加顶层收入份额。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个分析税收误报对收入不平等估计影响的统计框架，揭示了比例误报假设的理论局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议研究人员应使用误报模式的微观数据，关注收入群体内的误报异质性，并在从报告收入推算真实收入时明确考虑误报的不确定性。

title: From Yoga to Cybernetics: Intellectual Lineage, Ethical Recursion, and the Adhikaram Pentad
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: From Yoga to Cybernetics: Intellectual Lineage, Ethical Recursion, and the Adhikaram Pentad

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author, Vendan Ananda Kumararajah, is the originator of the A3 Model (Aram–Aanavam–Adhikaram) and has published books and articles elaborating its theoretical and practical applications. The present paper develops this framework further and situates it within intellectual and historical lineages. The author affirms that this paper is written in good faith for scholarly dissemination and does not involve any financial conflicts of interest. The author is committed to keeping the A3 Model open source and accessible for academic, institutional, and public benefit.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, clinical trials, or sensitive personal data, and therefore did not require formal ethics approval. The work is based on conceptual analysis, historical sources, and theoretical development of the A3 Model.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received in the preparation of this manuscript. The research, writing, and development of the A3 Model were independently conducted by the author as part of an ongoing open-source initiative.

detail.abstract: This paper explores the intellectual lineage between Indian philosophical traditions, particularly Tamil Saiva Siddhantam of the Meykandar/Tirumular school and Stafford Beer's management cybernetics. Drawing on biographical, textual, and conceptual evidence, it argues that Beer's engagement with yoga, tantra, and Gandhian discourse during his service in Punjab reflects a partial absorption of Indic metaphysical logics that closely parallel the Adhikaram pentad of Saiva Siddhantam. The paper situates this convergence in the context of the A3 Model (Aram-Aanavam-Adhikaram), a new order cybernetic framework that formalises ethics, distortion, and legitimacy as structural primitives. It proposes that acknowledging these lineages is not merely an exercise in intellectual history but a step toward more legitimate, globally grounded frameworks for AI governance and systemic transformation.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了印度哲学传统（特别是泰米尔湿婆悉檀多学派）与斯塔福德·比尔的管理控制论之间的思想渊源，提出了A3模型作为新的控制论框架，并认为承认这些渊源有助于建立更合法的AI治理框架。
AI.research_question: 印度哲学传统（特别是泰米尔湿婆悉檀多学派）与斯塔福德·比尔的管理控制论之间存在怎样的思想渊源？
AI.motivation: 探索不同文化传统间的思想交流，为AI治理和系统转型提供更全球化、合法性的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 湿婆悉檀多学派的Adhikaram五元论、A3模型（Aram-Aanavam-Adhikaram）控制论框架。
AI.method: 基于传记、文本和概念证据的分析方法。
AI.findings: 比尔在旁遮普服役期间对瑜伽、密宗和甘地思想的研究反映了他对印度形而上学逻辑的部分吸收，这些逻辑与湿婆悉檀多的Adhikaram五元论密切相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了印度哲学传统与管理控制论之间的思想联系，提出了A3模型作为新的控制论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI治理和系统转型提供了更全球化、合法性的理论框架基础。

detail.abstract:
On April 2nd 2025, after markets closed, the United States announced steep “Liberation Day” tariffs against most of its trading partners, many of which announced retaliatory tariffs. Market uncertainty spiked, consistent with the magnitudes and scope of the tariffs being unexpected. The prospect of a global trade war sent US stock markets down over ten percent until the US “paused” its tariffs on April 9th 2025, whereupon markets recovered. Portfolios of the stocks of firms headquartered in “redder” (more Republicans per Democrat) counties lost more value during this window.

publicationDetails.detailsText: NBER Working Paper No. w34300

detail.abstract:
This paper develops an asset-pricing model to evaluate the credibility of Hong Kong’s Linked Exchange Rate System (LERS). Allowing for imperfect peg credibility, we derive closed-form solutions for exchange rates and option prices under potential regime shifts. Using HKD option data, we estimate market-implied probabilities of peg survival and the fundamental value of the HKD. Our results show that credibility fluctuates with U.S. interest rate hikes, local liquidity conditions, and Chinese currency dynamics. Compared with more standard Black-Scholes-based models, our approach provides more realistic assessments of peg sustainability.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.research_question: 如何评估香港联系汇率制度的可信度？

AI.findings: 挂钩可信度随美国利率上升、本地流动性状况和中国货币动态而波动，模型比标准Black-Scholes模型提供更现实的挂钩可持续性评估

AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和市场参与者提供更准确的挂钩可持续性评估工具，有助于风险管理

title: Climate Risk and Stock Returns
affiliations: Florida International University (FIU) - Department of Economics

detail.title: Climate Risk and Stock Returns
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the dynamic effects of global climate risk on the stock returns of 28 countries using country-specific structural vector autoregression models from 2003 to 2025. Empirical results suggest that the impact of climate risk shocks, proxied by the Niño 3.4 sea surface temperature anomalies, is highly heterogeneous. Stock markets in several European and emerging economies, such as Chile, Czechia, Denmark, Hungary, Iceland, Mexico, New Zealand, Sweden, and Switzerland, respond positively, while markets in the United States and Korea react negatively to El Niño events. These climate risk shocks explain a significant portion of stock return volatility, reaching up to 9.0% in Hungary. A central contribution is the finding that financial markets primarily react to unexpected climate anomalies rather than forecasted ones. This indicates that while markets efficiently price predictable information, climate surprises are a genuine and unpriced risk factor. Robustness checks further suggest largely positive stock market responses to climate risk before 2014 reversing into a subsequent period of predominantly negative impacts, a shift reflecting new global policies. The results establish climate risk as a significant, country-specific, and dynamic factor requiring sophisticated analysis by investors and policymakers.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用结构向量自回归模型分析全球气候风险对28个国家股票收益的动态影响，发现气候风险冲击的影响具有高度异质性，金融市场主要对意外气候异常而非预测性信息做出反应，且2014年前后市场反应发生显著转变。
AI.research_question: 全球气候风险如何动态影响不同国家的股票市场收益？
AI.motivation: 随着气候变化日益成为全球性挑战，理解气候风险对金融市场的影响对投资者和政策制定者至关重要，但目前对气候风险冲击的异质性和动态效应研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于有效市场假说和风险定价理论，探讨可预测与不可预测气候信息在金融市场中的定价差异。
AI.method: 使用国家特定的结构向量自回归模型，以厄尔尼诺3.4海表温度异常作为气候风险代理变量，分析2003-2025年数据。
AI.findings: 气候风险冲击影响高度异质：部分欧洲和新兴市场国家股票收益正向反应，而美国和韩国市场负向反应；气候风险可解释高达9.0%的股票收益波动；金融市场主要对意外气候异常做出反应；2014年前后市场反应发生转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 确立了气候风险作为显著、国家特定和动态的风险因子，揭示了市场对可预测与不可预测气候信息的差异化反应机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供气候风险管理的量化依据，为政策制定者设计气候适应政策提供实证支持，强调需要针对不同国家特点进行差异化分析。

title: When an Insurance Rep Calls Mid-Surgery: What's the Real Breakdown?

detail.title: When an Insurance Rep Calls Mid-Surgery: What's the Real Breakdown?
detail.abstract: An incident involving Dr. Elisabeth Potter, a breast cancer surgeon in Texas, has gone viral-and for understandable reasons. According to multiple reports, Dr. Potter paused mid-surgery to take a phone call from UnitedHealthcare about approval for her patient's procedure. Dr. Potter posted a video of the phone call online, letting everyone see the process from her point of view. It's a jarring scene: a physician, just scrubbed out, stepping away from the operating table to argue a case with an insurance representative. Post-Mangione, it's another test case for American health insurance.

AI.tldr: 德克萨斯州乳腺外科医生Elisabeth Potter在手术中途暂停，接听UnitedHealthcare关于患者手术批准的电话，并将通话视频发布到网上，展示了医生与保险公司代表争论的过程，这成为美国医疗保险体系的又一个测试案例。

title: Reassessing Services Trade Barriers: Evidence from Turkish Microdata and the STRI Framework
affiliations: The Republic of Turkey, Ministry of Trade

detail.title: Reassessing Services Trade Barriers: Evidence from Turkish Microdata and the STRI Framework

publicationDetails.detailsText: East Asian Economic Review Vol. 29 No. 2 (June 2025) pp. 139-199, https://dx.doi.org/10.11644/KIEP.EAER.2025.29.2.447
publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study examines two key challenges in services trade research: the reliability of trade data and the measurement of non-tariff barriers, particularly the Services Trade Restrictiveness Index (STRI). Using firm-level panel data from Türkiye with fixed effects, we show that international data limitations significantly affect empirical results and that the explanatory power of the gravity model declines with more detailed microdata. We also find that the STRI's link to trade flows is weaker and more sector-specific than assumed, questioning its methodological adequacy. Additionally, ad valorem equivalent (AVE) rates are estimated, revealing moderate barriers for Türkiye's exports but much higher protection in imports, notably in technical services and transport. The findings highlight the need for sector-specific liberalization and call for next-generation STRI indices that are dynamic, firm-responsive, and modular by regulatory dimension. We advocate for cautious interpretation of STRI-based estimates and encourage the use of microdata across countries to improve services trade analysis and policy design.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了服务贸易研究中的两大挑战：贸易数据可靠性和非关税壁垒测量。使用土耳其企业级面板数据发现，国际数据限制显著影响实证结果，STRI指数与贸易流量的关联比假设的更弱且更具行业特异性。建议开发新一代动态、企业响应式、按监管维度模块化的STRI指数。
AI.research_question: 服务贸易数据可靠性和非关税壁垒测量方法（特别是STRI指数）的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 服务贸易研究中存在数据可靠性和非关税壁垒测量两大关键挑战，需要实证验证现有方法的有效性
AI.theoretical_framework: 引力模型、服务贸易限制指数理论、非关税壁垒测量理论
AI.method: 使用土耳其企业级面板数据，采用固定效应模型进行实证分析
AI.findings: 国际数据限制显著影响实证结果；STRI指数与贸易流量的关联较弱且行业特异性强；土耳其出口面临中等壁垒，进口保护水平更高（特别是技术服务与运输）
AI.theory_contributions: 质疑STRI指数的理论充分性，提出引力模型在微观数据下的解释力下降，推动新一代STRI指数理论发展

reference: NBER Working Paper No. w34302
title: Playing with Blocs: Quantifying Decoupling
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - New York University, Abu Dhabi, Yale University - Department of Economics, University of Michigan, Department of Economics, University of Michigan - Department of Economics, University of Texas at Austin - Department of Economics,  and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Playing with Blocs: Quantifying Decoupling

publicationDetails.detailsText: NBER Working Paper No. w34302
publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We adopt a data-driven approach to measure trade fragmentation over the period 2015-2023. Countries are classified into three groups according to changes in their trade costs with the US and China: those shifting toward the US bloc, those shifting toward the China bloc, and those with no change in alignment. Roughly one-quarter of countries moved toward each bloc, while about half showed no realignment. We document that while cross-bloc trade costs rose, they were accompanied by falling within-bloc trade costs. We use a quantitative model to compute the real income effects of this reconfiguration of the global trade costs. The median country in the world, and the median country within each bloc, has 0.4-0.6% higher real income as a result of the observed decoupling, contrary to the widespread belief that fragmentation has been welfare-reducing. Finally, we find a modest amount of bloc misalignment: the median country moving to the US bloc would actually be better off moving to the China bloc, and vice versa. These results suggest that trade decoupling does not always follow trade-driven economic interests.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文采用数据驱动方法衡量2015-2023年贸易碎片化，发现约四分之一国家转向美国阵营，四分之一转向中国阵营，一半无变化。虽然跨阵营贸易成本上升，但阵营内贸易成本下降。定量模型显示，中位数国家因脱钩实际收入增长0.4-0.6%，与普遍认为碎片化损害福利的观点相反。此外存在阵营错配现象，表明贸易脱钩并不总是遵循经济利益。
AI.research_question: 贸易碎片化对全球贸易成本和实际收入的影响是什么？

AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易碎片化理论、贸易成本理论、国际贸易理论、定量贸易模型
AI.method: 数据驱动方法，将国家按与美中贸易成本变化分为三个阵营，使用定量模型计算实际收入效应
AI.findings: 1. 约25%国家转向美国阵营，25%转向中国阵营，50%无阵营变化；2. 跨阵营贸易成本上升但阵营内贸易成本下降；3. 中位数国家实际收入增长0.4-0.6%；4. 存在阵营错配现象
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战贸易碎片化必然损害福利的传统观点，提出阵营内贸易成本下降可能抵消跨阵营成本上升，为理解贸易脱钩的经济效应提供新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供贸易碎片化实际影响的量化证据，帮助各国在贸易阵营选择中做出更符合经济利益的决策

title: Maternity Leave Extensions and Gender Gaps: Evidence from an Online Job Platform
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - Department of Economics, Peking University - National School of Development (NSD) and Peking University

detail.title: Maternity Leave Extensions and Gender Gaps: Evidence from an Online Job Platform

publicationDetails.detailsText: NBER Working Paper No. w34304
publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We investigate the unintended consequences of maternity leave extension on gender gaps in the labor market. Using millions of job applications on an online job platform and the staggered extension of maternity leave across Chinese provinces, we find that an average increase (22%) in the length of paid maternity leave led to a 3.7 percentage point decrease in positive callbacks to female applicants relative to their male counterparts. In response, female job seekers submitted 4.4 more job applications, shifted toward jobs with 5.4% lower wages, and experienced 0.9 weeks longer job search duration than male applicants. We also find that government subsidies that partially cover firms' wage costs of extended maternity leave help alleviate its adverse impact on gender disparities in hiring.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 产假延长导致女性求职者获得面试机会的概率下降3.7个百分点，女性需提交更多申请、接受更低工资的工作，且求职周期更长。政府补贴可缓解这种负面影响。

affiliations: , The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) and Princeton University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Price and Volume Divergence in China’s Real Estate Markets: The Role of Local Governments

publicationDetails.detailsText: NBER Working Paper No. w34303
publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
During the Covid-19 pandemic (2020-2022), Chinese cities witnessed a paradox: residential land and new house prices surged while transaction volumes plummeted. We attribute this to local governments’ active price management through supply controls, land acquisitions by Local Government Financing Vehicles (LGFVs), and limits on new home sales permits. Cities more dependent on land sales and land-backed debt before the pandemic experienced greater price increases and price-volume divergence, with LGFVs buying more land at higher prices than other buyers. These interventions helped sustain fiscal financing but deepened developers’ financial distress, revealing unintended consequences of local governments’ fiscal strategies during downturns.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School, London Business School, London Business School and London Business School

detail.title: The Impact of Carcinogenic Risk Exposure on Housing Values: Estimates From Chemical Reclassifications

publicationDetails.detailsText: NBER Working Paper No. w34305
publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We quantify the impact of perceived cancer risk on housing values using widely advertised national reclassifications of chemical carcinogenicity in the United States. Combining these information events with an empirical design that compares changes in house values closer to affected toxic plants against those farther away isolates the effect of cancer risk news from other local factors. Focusing on plants previously emitting reclassified carcinogenic chemicals, we estimate a 1-2% decline in housing values within a 3-mile radius compared to those located farther away. The effects are stronger in areas with higher media presence underscoring the role of salience as a mechanism.

reference: NBER Working Paper No. w34301
title: Equity Frictions and Firm Ownership
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - New York University

detail.title: Equity Frictions and Firm Ownership

publicationDetails.detailsText: NBER Working Paper No. w34301
publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
In this paper, I document systematic heterogeneity in ownership and financing of firms across Eurozone countries. To rationalize these differences, I build a quantitative general equilibrium model of workers and entrepreneurs who choose debt and equity financing of their firms, subject to rich country-specific financial frictions. The novel data on firm ownership and financing, combined with the structure of the model, allows me to quantify the level of debt and equity frictions in each country. Quantitatively, I find much larger output effects from equity frictions: harmonizing them across countries would lead to nearly four times larger output effects compared to debt frictions, and removing them would increase aggregate output by 75\% more. The larger impact on output is due not only to the estimated levels and dispersion of equity frictions, but also to the fact that equity provides greater risk sharing, which further incentivizes entrepreneurs to expand their firms. Through their effect on risk sharing, equity frictions also rationalize the observed negative relationship between equity financing and wealth inequality. Quantitatively, they are responsible for over 70\% of the explained variation in top wealth shares across countries.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文量化分析了欧元区各国企业所有权和融资的异质性，发现股权摩擦对产出的影响远大于债务摩擦，且股权融资通过风险分担机制与财富不平等呈负相关。
AI.research_question: 欧元区各国企业所有权和融资结构存在系统性差异的原因是什么？这些差异对产出和财富不平等有何影响？
AI.motivation: 欧元区各国在企业所有权和融资结构上存在显著差异，理解这些差异的根源及其经济影响对于政策制定和区域经济一体化具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于工人和企业家选择债务和股权融资的定量一般均衡模型，考虑各国特定的金融摩擦因素。
AI.method: 使用新颖的企业所有权和融资数据，结合结构模型量化各国债务和股权摩擦水平。
AI.findings: 股权摩擦对产出的影响远大于债务摩擦：统一各国股权摩擦可使产出效应增加近4倍，消除股权摩擦可使总产出增加75%以上。股权融资与财富不平等呈负相关，股权摩擦解释了各国顶级财富份额变异的70%以上。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个包含金融摩擦的定量一般均衡框架，揭示了股权摩擦通过风险分担机制影响企业扩张和财富分配的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了量化证据，表明减少股权摩擦比债务摩擦更能促进经济增长和减少财富不平等，对欧元区金融一体化政策具有重要启示。

detail.title: Sellers' inflation, price dispersion and substitutability: Schumpeter meets Lerner
detail.abstract: The relationship between firm markups and inflation remains a topic of contention. Empirical findings suggest that many firms were able to maintain or increase their markups and profits amidst the recent period of wide-ranging cost shocks. This phenomenon, often referred to as sellers’ inflation, raises two questions: i) why do firms change their price-setting strategies from previously competing for market shares via lower prices to raising prices in proportion or even excess of a price shock, and ii) why can they do so without impeding their market share and profitability? We argue that current supply-side explanations exhibit several theoretical and empirical shortcomings and instead propose a demand-based alternative based on the textbook argument of distorted price signals. We argue that higher price dispersion during periods of price shocks reflect informational costs for consumers and reduce consumers’ price elasticity of demand by deranging the system of relative prices they oversee. Based on an agent-based model, we demonstrate that the combination of boundedly rational consumers and informational costs due to price dispersion enables firms to increase their markups and profits in response to wide-ranging cost-push shocks. As consumers increasingly struggle to monitor price changes, they become less able to adequately punish (or reward) firms for raising (or maintaining) prices. This straightforward mechanism offers a promising explanation for the emergence of sellers’ inflation

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于需求侧的解释，认为价格冲击期间的价格分散增加了消费者的信息成本，降低了价格弹性，使企业能够在成本冲击中提高加成和利润。
AI.research_question: 为什么企业在价格冲击期间能够从价格竞争转向提高价格，且不影响市场份额和盈利能力？
AI.motivation: 实证发现许多企业在广泛成本冲击中能够维持或提高加成和利润，这种现象被称为卖方通胀，现有供给侧解释存在理论和实证缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于教科书中的扭曲价格信号理论，价格分散反映消费者的信息成本，降低消费者的价格需求弹性。
AI.method: 基于代理模型，结合有限理性消费者和价格分散带来的信息成本。
AI.findings: 价格分散使消费者难以监控价格变化，降低其惩罚或奖励企业价格行为的能力，从而使企业能够在成本冲击中提高加成和利润。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了卖方通胀的需求侧解释机制，补充现有供给侧理论的不足。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解企业在成本冲击中的定价行为提供了新视角，对通胀管理和消费者保护政策具有启示意义。

title: Uncovering Subjective Models from Survey Expectations

detail.title: Uncovering Subjective Models from Survey Expectations
detail.abstract: Households perceive that macroeconomic variables move together differently from that implied by their actual realizations and sophisticated models. We use a structural test derived from a multivariate noisy-information framework and additional evidence from survey data and newspaper narratives to show that information friction alone cannot explain households’ tendency to associate higher future inflation with a worse labor market outlook. We also show that the subjective model uncovered from survey data implies amplified output responses to supply shocks, but dampened output and price responses to demand shocks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，家庭对宏观经济变量的感知与实际情况存在系统性偏差，信息摩擦无法完全解释家庭倾向于将高通胀与更差的劳动力市场前景关联的现象。研究还发现，从调查数据揭示的主观模型意味着供给冲击会放大产出反应，而需求冲击会减弱产出和价格反应。
AI.research_question: 为什么家庭倾向于将高通胀与更差的劳动力市场前景相关联？这种主观模型对宏观经济冲击的反应有何影响？
AI.motivation: 家庭对宏观经济变量的感知与实际情况存在系统性差异，这种差异不能仅用信息摩擦来解释，需要探究其背后的认知机制和经济影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多元噪声信息框架的结构性检验，结合调查数据和报纸叙事分析。
AI.method: 使用来自多元噪声信息框架的结构性检验，结合调查数据和报纸叙事分析作为补充证据。
AI.findings: 信息摩擦无法完全解释家庭将高通胀与更差劳动力市场前景关联的倾向；主观模型意味着供给冲击会放大产出反应，而需求冲击会减弱产出和价格反应。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了家庭宏观经济认知的系统性偏差，超越了传统信息摩擦理论的解释范围，为行为宏观经济学提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 有助于理解家庭经济决策的形成机制，为政策制定者设计更有效的沟通策略和宏观经济政策提供参考。

detail.abstract: Amid evolving global trade policy and rising tariff uncertainty, understanding how small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) form expectations about future costs and adjust their pricing is critical for assessing how the recently imposed tariffs on US imports could impact consumer prices. To that end, we analyze several waves of a survey of owners and other decision-makers at a nationally representative sample of US SMBs, defined as companies that employ 500 or fewer workers. We focus on waves conducted during the period of December 2024 to August 2025.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了2024年12月至2025年8月期间对美国中小企业的调查数据，探讨了在全球贸易政策变化和关税不确定性背景下，中小企业如何形成对未来成本的预期并调整定价策略。
AI.research_question: 中小企业如何形成对未来成本的预期，并如何根据这些预期调整定价策略？
AI.motivation: 理解在关税不确定性增加的背景下，中小企业对成本预期的形成和定价调整机制，对于评估美国进口关税对消费者价格的影响至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预期形成理论、定价决策理论、中小企业行为经济学
AI.method: 对全国代表性样本的美国中小企业（员工不超过500人）进行多轮调查，分析2024年12月至2025年8月期间的调查数据
AI.findings: 研究结果将揭示中小企业在关税不确定性下的预期形成机制和定价调整行为
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富中小企业预期形成和定价决策的理论框架，特别是在贸易政策不确定性背景下的行为模式
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估关税政策对消费者价格的影响提供实证依据，帮助中小企业更好地应对贸易政策变化
